lines.say: Milo made a horror game. At 2 AM, it pulled him and his best friend inside.
Find three fuses, power the elevator, ride it down. That's the only way out.
lines.cap: Find 3 fuses, power the elevator, ride it down. That's the only way out.

lines.say: And Jay? Never stop looking at the dolls.
Because in Still Here, the dolls only move when nobody is watching.
Uh, Milo? That doll was way further away a second ago.
Then the lights died. And something tall stepped into the hall.
The Hollow. It hunts by sound. Hide!
Its footsteps stopped. Right outside Jay's locker.
Milo kicked his locker open, and fired the camera flash.
Fuse three. The elevator hummed to life, and the doors slammed shut, an inch from its claws.
lines.cap: Fuse 3. The elevator hummed to life, and the doors slammed shut, an inch from its claws.

lines.say: Then the floor dropped. Right back into Milo's bedroom.
Still Here is a real game on Pulsebox. Make a room, send your friends the code, and play it tonight. If you dare.
lines.cap: Still Here is a real game on PULSEBOX. Make a room, send your friends the code, and play it tonight. If you dare.

lines.say: But the laptop wasn't done with them. Next time, the ocean.
lines.cap: But the laptop wasn't done with them. Next time... the ocean.
